name: Clinical Trial
source:
A suspense tale about signing up to test psychiatric drugs for money and provider-patient relations.

RPGMaker story driven game. Visual novel you can walk around in. Reality testing simulator. 

Intended for 18+ audiences only. Contains horror elements and disturbing themes.

[From [url=https://homieshouse.itch.io/clinical-trial/]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于报名测试精神药物以获取金钱和医患关系的悬疑故事。

RPGMaker故事驱动游戏。你可以在其中走动的视觉小说。现实测试模拟器。

仅适用于18岁以上观众。包含恐怖元素和令人不安的主题。

[来自[url=https://homieshouse.itch.io/clinical-trial/]itch.io[/url]]
